data.body: FINAL on story B's AC5, after 7 real review runs. Runs 6 and 7 closed the last route: with the plan's inventory made COMPLETE (all six files, verified by git grep) but still admitting grep-derivation, the criterion correctly stayed SILENT and the review returned PASS - even after I removed a genuine contradiction I had introduced in the rubric (the non-findings section said a complete inventory is never a finding, which overrode the stated-method branch). A reviewer declining to flag a demonstrably complete inventory is right, not broken. So the situation is a pincer with no plan shape in between: inventory incomplete -> criterion fires at validity 1.0 but the BLOCKING built-ins G1G2/G6/E4 fire on the same evidence and win coach selection; inventory complete -> the criterion correctly abstains. Tuning the rubric further until it manufactures a finding would be gaming my own oracle, so I stopped. Substantive conclusion recorded in docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md: the DETECTION half of this criterion is largely REDUNDANT with rebar's shipped built-ins (which are agent-tier, cite real line numbers, and block - in run 5 a built-in even named the monkeypatch string site), and the genuinely distinctive part is the METHOD coaching, which is precisely the part that cannot reliably reach the agent because it travels through LLM coach selection. Story B therefore stays IN_PROGRESS, not closed: the completion verifier correctly refused the close on AC5 and I am not forcing it. The rubric fix and the runs 6-7 evidence were amended into change 1024 (Change-Id preserved, re-pushed as a new patch set alongside 1025); gates re-running.
